audit_basis.mood_board: Ten user-supplied references: nine photo_2026-06-11 images and photo_2026-06-18_04-29-36.jpg
audit_basis.confidence_limit: Installed coverage is based on package and asset filenames. A neutral-noon and saturated-dusk visual audition is still required before approval or generation.

families.title: Alien understory, meadow filler, vines, and flowers
families.silhouette_requirement: Fan rosettes, spear and round leaves, bulbs, vines, moss colonies, and uneven meadow islands.
families.material_requirement: Parameterized coral, crimson, violet, acid-green, and restrained cyan variants with no baked lighting.
families.variant_requirement: Audition at least three visibly different silhouettes before selecting any filler family.
families.next_action: Visible pack audition; promote only approved meshes into the manual palette before any PCG use.

families.title: Crimson ribbon-droop canopy tree
families.silhouette_requirement: Asymmetrical wide crown of long drooping ribbon fronds; must not read as an ordinary palm.
families.material_requirement: Hot coral and crimson foliage with indigo shadows and optional sparse violet bulbs.
families.variant_requirement: Three adults, one juvenile, and one damaged or dead form if the installed family is approved.
families.next_action: Audition installed droop and dangle trees at player, jetpack, and ship distance; generate only if all fail the silhouette test.

families.title: Needles, caprock shelves, cliffs, obsidian rocks, and formations
families.silhouette_requirement: Large low-frequency planes, vertical striation, needle fins, broad shelves, and varied clustered bases.
families.material_requirement: Terracotta, dusty rose, sandstone, and muted plum strata with high roughness and vertex variation.
families.variant_requirement: Near, mid, and far representations; repeated forms must have at least three silhouettes.
families.next_action: Audition installed cliff and hoodoo families; reserve generation for non-traversal hero silhouettes that remain missing.

families.title: Portal rings, bridges, channels, and cliff-integrated spaceport
families.silhouette_requirement: Perfect rings and clean radial segments embedded into rough geology with readable traversal routes.
families.material_requirement: Neutral metal or pale stone with separate restrained cyan and magenta emissive channels.
families.variant_requirement: Intact and damaged modular sections with exact snapping and deterministic collision.
families.next_action: Kitbash and hand-model final traversal geometry; generated meshes may be concept references only, never final collision-critical structures.

families.title: Pale buttressed coral umbrella tree
families.silhouette_requirement: Pale buttressed trunk, five to eight thick horizontal coral canopy plates, root flares, and sparse tendrils.
families.material_requirement: Calcified cream and dusty coral with turquoise wet accents; separable trunk, plates, and tendrils.
families.variant_requirement: Three adults, one juvenile, one damaged or dead form, and near, mid, and far representations.
families.next_action: Run a final visible cross-pack audition; authorize an isolated Meshy or Tripo concept and source mesh only if no installed silhouette passes.

families.title: Fungal cathedral tree and bracket-fungi family
families.silhouette_requirement: Colossal buttressed trunk, traversable-looking root arches, bracket shelves, and separate giant and floor fungi.
families.material_requirement: Charcoal and plum bark with sparse cyan seams and magenta fungi; no ordinary Earth leaf crown.
families.variant_requirement: Three adults, one juvenile, one damaged or dead tree, plus separate bracket and floor-fungus sets.
families.next_action: After visible confirmation of the filename audit, create isolated concept sheets and generation trials; manually rebuild any gameplay-critical root arch collision.

families.title: Floating balloon pods and drifting spore bodies
families.silhouette_requirement: Several buoyant pod bodies with readable asymmetry; tether strands and movement are separate Niagara or manual systems.
families.material_requirement: Soft coral, violet, or pale cyan bodies with restrained focal emissive details and no full-surface glow.
families.variant_requirement: At least three pod silhouettes, one juvenile, and one collapsed or damaged state.
families.next_action: Generate only the physical pod and anchor meshes after visible pack review; author tether and drift behavior separately.

families.title: Waterfalls, mist, dust, pollen, spray, spores, and light shafts
families.silhouette_requirement: Readable local atmosphere that supports, rather than obscures, hero silhouettes and traversal.
families.material_requirement: Parameterized color and density with restrained emissive response and correct planetary-layer containment.
families.variant_requirement: Near and far systems with scalability and bounded spawn regions.
families.next_action: Use installed VFX systems; do not use Meshy or Tripo for volumetric or particle effects.

families.title: Polar and tundra plants, rocks, and surface props
families.silhouette_requirement: Wind-shaped tundra cover, ice-crusted rock anchors, sparse boreal transition forms, and readable snow breaks.
families.material_requirement: Cool pale surfaces with indigo shadow detail and controlled cyan ice accents.
families.variant_requirement: At least three plant and rock silhouettes before any repeated biome placement.
families.next_action: Visually audit existing snow layers and ice flowers, then prefer a licensed dedicated tundra pack before generation.
